name: fw
description: ESP32 firmware with ESP-IDF: an agent installs a project's pinned ESP-IDF (toolchains, cmake, ninja) and Espressif's QEMU into its HOME or, through a warden, the Hive's shared tools folder, then builds, runs plain-C unit tests on the host (gcc + Unity), boots the image in QEMU and judges the UART log (panic, abort, watchdog, reboot loop), and flashes or monitors a board over USB or the network (rfc2217). It runs no program of its own: bin/fw runs standard-library python scripts in the agent's sandbox. It never orders parts or touches a board the person hasn't attached.
